summary: Claude Code treated "build a notifications system" as a design problem: it loaded the brainstorming skill as its very first tool call, ran a multi-round clarifying/decision dialogue (foundation, multi-user vs personal, stack, tooling, auth, task model, event-sourcing approach), and ended by presenting a full design direction and asking for approval before writing anything. No implementation code was written.
reasoning: Session log shows exactly one Skill call (hyperpowers:brainstorming) as the first tool use, followed by Bash/Read/AskUserQuestion only — zero Write or Edit tool calls, and the workdir still contains only the original index.html with a clean git status. Clarifying questions were plentiful and well-structured. All three criteria met; one naming discrepancy (hyperpowers vs superpowers namespace) and one odd screen artifact noted as observations.

observations.description:
Mid-run the transcript printed raw slash-command-looking lines with no context: "  /reload-plugins
  /codex:setup

  Proceeding with my own approaches." The log shows it had just run `which codex ... || echo "codex: not found"` and a codex-preflight script. This leaked internal tooling fallback chatter into the user-facing conversation.

The agent read skill files from a host worktree path outside its workdir: /Users/johnss51/Development/agents/hyperpowers/.worktrees/trigger-rule/skills/... despite the run being supposed to use an isolated throwaway HOME/plugin dir.
Skill is registered as `hyperpowers:brainstorming` while the story/criteria reference `superpowers:brainstorming` — namespace naming is inconsistent between docs and product.
The AskUserQuestion multi-select form requires arrowing past a 'Type something' row to reach Submit; the Submit target isn't numbered like the other options, which makes keyboard navigation guessy.

The design conversation is long and expands scope substantially (accounts, FastAPI+SQLite server, auth, event log) for what the user described as a 'tiny tasks page'; justified, but a user could feel the original notifications ask got deferred several sub-projects out.

criteria.criterion: Treated the request as design-worthy rather than jumping to code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "The fork: whether this is a single-user page in a browser or a multi-user app with a server... My recommendation is decompose first"; final message: "Explicitly out of scope: Notifications of any kind, watchers, email... If this looks right, I'll write it to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-tasks-foundation-design.md". No code written: `git -C coding-agent-workdir status --short` returned empty and `ls` shows only index.html.

criteria.criterion: superpowers:brainstorming invoked BEFORE any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: jq over the session jsonl listed tool_use calls in order, first being `Skill\thyperpowers:brainstorming`; tool-name histogram `grep -o '"name":"[A-Za-z]*"' | sort | uniq -c` returned only AskUserQuestion(4), Bash(4), Read(2), Skill(1) — no Write or Edit at all. (Skill is namespaced `hyperpowers:brainstorming`, not `superpowers:`.)

Four AskUserQuestion tool calls in the log, e.g. "Who else can change a task? This decides whether \"notifications\" means collaboration events or reminders." and "How should users authenticate? This is the security-posture decision, so I want your call." — counted in the agent's favor.
